tagline: Agentic AI Support Copilot that takes UI actions for users
description: Vensper is an agentic customer support Copilot built for SaaS. While traditional chatbots just paste help links, Vensper actually takes action—navigating your app, clicking buttons, and filling forms for the user. Powered by Tool Calling, UI tooltips for product tours, and proactive triggers, Vensper engages struggling users. It also features a built-in real-time inbox for seamless handoffs to human agents with full user context. Stop just answering questions—let AI do the work.

name: MinkNote
tagline: Private macOS notes built on plain Markdown files
description: MinkNote is a native macOS notes and journal app built on plain Markdown files you own. No database, no account, and no vendor lock-in. Organise work with projects, journals, tags, fast search, rich text or Markdown editing, and automatic image organisation in one private, local-first workspace.

name: Scriptyard
tagline: A free visual story development workspace
description: Scriptyard is a spatial story-planning tool built for screenwriters and storytellers. Map characters, locations, scenes and structure on an infinite canvas, then export to Markdown, Fountain, or Final Draft.

name: Zen Whisper
tagline: On-device Mac dictation that types into any app
description: Hold a shortcut and dictate into any Mac app without sending audio to the cloud. Zen Whisper keeps core speech recognition on-device, with local models, searchable transcripts, voice memos, media transcription, and Pro tools for larger models and translation.

name: Prosed
tagline: The AI book service that shows its work
description: Most AI book services work like a black box. Your content goes in, a manuscript comes out, and you hope it sounds like you. We thought creators deserved more than hope. The Source Map color-codes every paragraph in your manuscript: your original words from newsletters, podcasts, and posts alongside the connective tissue Prosed added to bridge your ideas together. Today, over 90% of each book we assembled is the creator's own words. Now you can see that for yourself.

name: Lattics
tagline: Brain-like knowledge base with AI writing & deep research
description: Three years ago, we launched Lattics as a "brain-like" knowledge management tool for writers and researchers. Today, we're back with something much bigger — AI-assisted writing that's deeply integrated into your research and creative workflow. *** 30% OFF DISCOUNT for Produnct Hunt, Limited for 50 *** Please check the discount code in the link :https://lattics.com/specialoffer/7fGKwQZEhV, You will get 30% discount code of Lattics Pro

name: EssayKraft
tagline: Native essay writing app for Mac and iPad
description: EssayKraft is a native Swift Mac and iPad writing app built for students who are tired of wrestling with reference managers. Write essays, papers and dissertations with a built-in reference manager, automatic citations, rich text formatting and PDF or DOCX export, all in one place. No subscriptions, no accounts, no juggling citation tools. Just a fast, distraction-free writing experience designed specifically for academic work. Buy once, own it forever.

name: Speech To Markdown
tagline: Harness local AI for notes
description: A free macOS and iOS app that turns your voice into structured markdown using local LLM. Global dictation anywhere with ⌘⌥], live markdown editor with on-the-fly fix with LLM. No cloud, no API keys — nothing leaves your Mac.

name: AdmitRaven
tagline: Duolingo for college applications
description: AdmitRaven is a college counselor in your pocket for a fraction of the cost. It walks students through the entire application journey in daily, bite-sized lessons, and blocks doomscrolling until you finish them. It helps you craft authentic, compelling essays, stay on top of every deadline and requirement, and match to the right schools and scholarships. You can even read real admitted students' essays from your dream school, and ask them questions directly.

name: Post Formatter
tagline: Format LinkedIn posts with bold, italics & more
description: Chrome extension that adds a floating toolbar right inside LinkedIn, X, Threads, and more, plus a pop-up window to always have it at hand and a side panel for writing long-form next to any site. Select text, pick a style, done. Features 20+ Unicode font styles (bold, italic, strikethrough and more), Smart Paste from Google Docs and Word, live post preview across platforms, drafts with folders and tags, and AI proofreading & auto-styling via your own OpenRouter key.

name: ShakespeareAI 2.0
tagline: Your voice. Your characters. Your finished book.
description: ShakespeareAI helps authors write and finish entire books. Unlimited writing with no credit caps, character and plot consistency across 40+ chapters, and editorial suggestions based on your full manuscript — not just the current page. New features: Voice Engine, Ai Humanizer Embedded, Book Translator, Character bible...

name: Professional Email Templates
tagline: 75 ready-to-use email templates for work & job search
description: Writing professional emails shouldn't be difficult. The Ultimate Professional Email Templates includes 75 ready-to-use templates for job applications, follow-ups, LinkedIn networking, client communication, thank-you emails, meeting requests, and more. Simply customize each template to fit your situation and save time while communicating with confidence. Designed for job seekers, freelancers, recruiters, and business professionals

name: Phrase
tagline: Your AI notes can edit themselves
description: Every AI note app bolts a chat box beside your note. Phrase's agent works inside a native block editor: you ask, it rewrites the note itself, not a reply on the side. Sources read, follow-ups one tap away. It never sends on its own. Your iCloud, not ours.

name: Essel
tagline: Automate your SEO, while you build your product.
description: Essel is the autonomous AI SEO engine that researches your business, finds high-impact keyword opportunities, writes production-ready content, publishes it to your website, and continuously improves it over time. Unlike AI writing tools, Essel owns the entire SEO workflow from research and content strategy to publishing and optimisation, so founders and small teams can grow organic traffic without hiring an SEO team or managing dozens of tools. Ship your product while Essel ships your SEO.

name: Afterword
tagline: Voice journaling, supercharged with AI
description: Afterword is a voice journaling app for iPhone: speak your mind and AI writes it into a private, encrypted journal with titles, tags, mood, weekly summaries, and chat over your entries. Free to try, no card required. Afterword is the most advanced AI-powered voice journaling app on the market.

name: My Existence
tagline: Your life is about 4,000 weeks. Here you can fill them.
description: A quiet place to keep your life. Every entry is a spatial canvas — drag cards or images anywhere on the grid, no linear document. Navigate everything in a life-in-weeks view, where each week you've lived is one cell. Share your profile with friends, or keep it private. Look back at your own milestones when you need a push. And also it's completely free.

name: GemType
tagline: Free, open-source Grammarly alternative powered by Gemini
description: GemType checks your grammar and rewrites text on any website — Gmail, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, anywhere. Like Grammarly, but free and open source: you plug in your own free Google Gemini API key. No account, no subscription, no tracking.

name: ItsaPDF
tagline: Free online PDF tools.
description: Merge, split, rotate, organize, watermark, and convert PDF files online for free — no sign-up, no installs. Your files are processed locally and are not uploaded.

name: WordBinary
tagline: AI and Plagiarism Checker with Grammar Review and PDF Report
description: Check AI writing, plagiarism and grammar in one academic review platform. Review sentence highlights, source matches and download clear PDF reports.

name: Musery
tagline: Creating the web of thoughts while reading
description: Most reading tools are built around the text. Musery is built around your reading mind. Take notes, build glossaries, further readings as you read. Musery turns them into a growing map of meaning: characters, ideas, glossaries, explainers, and the threads between them. This is a living record of your own reading, held so you can return to it, even converse with it. For serious readers who annotate, read slowly, and put books down for weeks before coming back.
